description: Check whether postings are still open, by the slugs search results carry — up to 50 per call. Use before acting on a saved shortlist: each posting answers open, closed or not_found, with when it closed or was last seen live.

slugs.description: posting identifiers, as carried by search results' slug; up to 50 are checked per call

name: check_jobs_open

closed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; when freehire saw the posting close

last_seen_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; when a re-crawl last confirmed the posting live

unchecked.description: slugs beyond the per-call cap, which were not checked

title: Check whether postings are still open
